inventory.name: register
inventory.title: Register
inventory.summary: Register a time-lapse by translation-only phase correlation on a stable channel, applied to every channel at full resolution.

inventory.name: register_three_channel
inventory.title: Register Three Channel
inventory.summary: Register three-channel phase/green/red organotypic time-lapses on the red neuronal channel.

inventory.name: export_registered_stack
inventory.title: Export Registered Stack
inventory.summary: Export cropped registered raw two-channel stacks with no unmixing, normalisation or rescaling.

inventory.name: remove_cosmic_rays
inventory.title: Remove Cosmic Rays
inventory.summary: Replace cosmic-ray damage using one outlier rule asked of a pixel, of a line and of the bleed off a saturated pixel, after registration.

inventory.name: remove_static_background
inventory.title: Remove Static Background
inventory.summary: Remove the static background and shot noise for display only, preserving pulse amplitude at circadian periods.

inventory.name: display_filter
inventory.title: Display Filter
inventory.summary: Minimally filtered bioluminescence display that keeps the background visible so the channel merges without looking clipped; display only.

inventory.name: background
inventory.title: Background
inventory.summary: Estimate the off-tissue background from the structural channel, never from the image corners, and check the tissue mask actually contains the bioluminescence.

inventory.name: segment
inventory.title: Segment
inventory.summary: Detect still cells by soma prominence and watershed, then sweep for further candidates. No minimum cell area, by rule.

inventory.name: automatic_scn_outline
inventory.title: Automatic Scn Outline
inventory.summary: Draw the accepted A007 two-lobe SCN outline from a registered red-channel time mean or selected hyperstack channel using a mean, maximum projection or chosen frame and valid-field mask, either retain that selected plane or stream one transform across every stack plane, apply the accepted A006 top-up orientation by default, and write a mask-relative square crop.

inventory.name: export_roi
inventory.title: Export Roi
inventory.summary: Write a RoiSet.zip Fiji can open: one region per segmented object, plus the SCN region and its two lobes.

inventory.name: extract_traces
inventory.title: Extract Traces
inventory.summary: One trace per segmented object, with its local ring subtracted, and dF/F against each trace's window mean rather than an instantaneous rolling baseline.

inventory.name: run_controls
inventory.title: Run Controls
inventory.summary: Area-matched decoys placed on tissue and read in absolute counts, plus the instrumental control that tests whether a rhythm is also off tissue, in another channel, or in image sharpness.

inventory.name: test_rhythm
inventory.title: Test Rhythm
inventory.summary: Period and cosinor for every trace, from circadian-workbench, and refused outright for a source with no instrumental control.

inventory.name: unmix
inventory.title: Unmix
inventory.summary: Linearly unmix a signal channel from a scaled autofluorescence channel, per frame, with one constant coefficient for the whole recording.

inventory.name: red_only_video
inventory.title: Red Only Video
inventory.summary: Linearly unmix microglial mCherry from autofluorescence on every raw frame, apply the saved registration transform, and export registered two-channel stacks plus timestamped red-only videos.

inventory.name: composite_video
inventory.title: Composite Video
inventory.summary: Render timestamped red/green microglia composite videos from registered two-channel stacks, correcting autofluorescence drift with a display-only endpoint gain curve.

inventory.name: phase_green_red_video
inventory.title: Phase Green Red Video
inventory.summary: Render timestamped green/red videos from a registered three-channel organotypic time-lapse and audit which channel is which, leaving the scientific data unnormalised.

inventory.name: stack_to_mp4
inventory.title: Stack To Mp4
inventory.summary: Render a TIFF time-lapse stack as an MP4 at a stated number of experimental hours per second, through a named colour map.

inventory.name: trace_panel
inventory.title: Trace Panel
inventory.summary: Draw a stack of time-trace panels from one or more trace CSVs, choosing which trace goes in which panel, merging several onto one panel, with independent control of colours, detrend, grey underlay, edge shading, time window, x ticks and vertical lines.

inventory.name: dluc_single_cell
inventory.title: Dluc Single Cell
inventory.summary: Segment and trace single-cell dLuc bioluminescence from a registered time-lapse, with detrending, rhythmicity tests, instrumental controls, quality-control figures and publication videos.

inventory.name: cry1_dluc_photon
inventory.title: Cry1 Dluc Photon
inventory.summary: Register four-channel Cry1-dLuc time-lapses on the bright-field channel and render photon-aware bioluminescence videos and quality-control figures, leaving the saved TIFF as raw transformed counts.

inventory.name: registration_figure
inventory.title: Registration Figure
inventory.summary: Draw the per-frame translation registration applied and the residual it left, from the stored shift table rather than from pixels.

inventory.name: cosmic_ray_preview
inventory.title: Cosmic Ray Preview
inventory.summary: Draw one frame before and after cosmic-ray removal beside the replacement mask, choosing the frame that lost the most pixels.

inventory.name: channel_figure
inventory.title: Channel Figure
inventory.summary: Draw each channel's frame and intensity histogram side by side, so a swapped or bleeding channel is visible before anything is measured.

inventory.name: frames_figure
inventory.title: Frames Figure
inventory.summary: Draw the first, middle and last frame of every channel with its timestamp, which catches a wrongly ordered hyperstack in three plane reads.

inventory.name: cell_overlay
inventory.title: Cell Overlay
inventory.summary: Draw the segmented objects as outlines over the tissue and the bioluminescence they were found in, with each object's local background ring.

inventory.name: roi_overlay
inventory.title: Roi Overlay
inventory.summary: Draw stored regions over the frame they were drawn on, so a region decision can be checked once instead of re-made every run.

inventory.name: publication_workbook
inventory.title: Publication Workbook
inventory.summary: Combine ReproFig figure data and every declared statistical test into one verified journal Excel workbook.

inventory.name: track
inventory.title: Track
inventory.summary: Give every cell an identity that outlives a frame: link the masked regions of one recording through movement, merges, splits and temporary invisibility, and write the label stack, the unclaimed ledger, the provenance sidecar, the motion evidence and the decision tables the measure step reads. Runs the frozen Motion engine shipped with the wheel.

inventory.name: measure
inventory.title: Measure
inventory.summary: Turn tracked labels into tables: one row per cell per frame, rolled up per cell and per frame, one folder per kind of table with one ledger each, and a manifest that fingerprints what went in and what came out. Every registered measurement module runs unless told which.

inventory.name: measure_expanded_outlines
inventory.title: Measure expanded outlines
inventory.summary: Compare original, exclusively expanded and background-corrected cell totals; every supplied cell limits growth.

inventory.name: measure_fixed_apertures
inventory.title: Measure fixed apertures
inventory.summary: Measure constant circle or square footprints following supplied native cell centroids; retain gaps and report overlap.

inventory.name: pool
inventory.title: Pool
inventory.summary: Concatenate an existing run's per-movie tables into <run>/pooled/, recording which movies contributed to each table, how many rows each gave and which columns one movie had that another did not.

inventory.name: window
inventory.title: Window
inventory.summary: Re-roll an existing run's summaries inside declared windows, per cell and per frame, with each window's values against its baseline window. Re-measures nothing.

inventory.name: contrasts
inventory.title: Contrasts
inventory.summary: Test every declared contrast over an existing run's pooled tables, one row per contrast per metric, corrected within each declared family. Pending until the Circadian Workbench importer of the rhythm stage lands.

inventory.name: measure_missing_gaps
inventory.title: Measure Missing Gaps
inventory.summary: Optionally measure original photons in stable missing-cell gaps after tracking, using the nearest accepted outline; write separate proposal rows only.

inventory.name: cell_review
inventory.title: Cell Review
inventory.summary: Export an offline linked shape-change map, rotatable outline history, animated cell cards and clickable recording barcode from saved identities and sharp original images.

inventory.name: cell_eligibility
inventory.title: Cell Eligibility
inventory.summary: Audit final Motion identities and write independent analysis, video and image label views without changing tracking or renumbering cells.

inventory.name: tracked_cell_video
inventory.title: Tracked Cell Video
inventory.summary: Draw configurable per-identity outlines over the original photon movie using the accepted review-video display defaults.

inventory.name: tracked_cell_image
inventory.title: Tracked Cell Image
inventory.summary: Draw configurable per-identity outlines over one original-photon frame for a still quality-control image.

inventory.name: cell_image_grid
inventory.title: Cell Image Grid
inventory.summary: Show every selected tracked cell through its best cycle or one shared event window using the Auto-Organotypic image grid.

inventory.name: cell_video_grid
inventory.title: Cell Video Grid
inventory.summary: Play every selected tracked cell through the original recording in a purple grid with live mask outlines and moving crops across mask gaps.

inventory.name: states
inventory.title: States
inventory.summary: Learn shared cell-frame states and describe their dynamics and separately tested rhythms.

inventory.name: cluster
inventory.title: Cluster
inventory.summary: Learn whole-cell fingerprints and describe cohort clusters with held-out reconstruction checks.

inventory.name: follow
inventory.title: Follow
inventory.summary: Review accepted cell identities over the recording, lifespan or recorded event windows; display only.

inventory.name: cell_card_video
inventory.title: Cell Card Video
inventory.summary: Animate sharp original cell crops alongside their raw intensity, three-frame mean and mask-area traces with a synchronized native-time cursor.

inventory.name: rhythm_discovery

inventory.summary: Run the rhythm discovery workflow on saved measurement tables.
